title: Verify Parts Technician can create and edit a part
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role. (this role has Catalog: View/Create and Edit - no Delete).
steps:
1. Click Parts and open the Catalog.
2. Click to add a new part, fill in the part name and part number, and save.
3. Open the part, change its description, and save.
expected: The part is created and the edit saves successfully.
